comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A new Legacy/transmutation alchemy MA will be added in Chapter 3: Pharos. It consists of the following 7 items:

Pharaoh's Robe -> Improved Pharaoh's Robe
Pharaoh's Headcloth -> Improved Pharaoh's Headcloth
Horus' Staff -> Pharaoh's Staff
Isis -> Goddess of Seafaring
Celebratory Wooden Paneling -> Special Pearl Purple Wooden Paneling
Celebratory Metal Paneling -> Special Pearl Purple Metal Paneling
The Statue of Bastet -> Bastet

Album reward is: Crown of Grapes
NPC: Hisar Reis(Tunis)

More details to come. Cheers.

Source: wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1311.html
